competencyTargets.label: Conduct regulatory compliance inspections
Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases
Target inspections and verify compliance using monitoring data and analytics
Manage field sample custody and field quality control
Build and maintain a defensible administrative record
Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites
Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary
Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings
Validate AI-generated work products before professional use
Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments
Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity
Assure the quality of environmental data from collection to release
Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure
Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty
Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field
Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work
Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work
Record provenance and AI involvement in work products
Communicate technical environmental information in writing and speech

topTasks.statement: Plan a compliance inspection from the facility's permit, compliance history and monitoring reports, listing the conditions to verify and the evidence to collect
Inspect a permitted facility or site against its permit conditions and applicable rules, recording observations, measurements and samples as evidence
Collect samples and photographs during an inspection under chain-of-custody procedures, so that the evidence is admissible in an enforcement proceeding
Write an inspection report stating findings of fact for each condition inspected, separating the inspector's observations from conclusions
Select the response the enforcement policy sets for each inspection finding, issuing a notice of violation, assistance letter or referral
Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them
Investigate a reported environmental violation, establishing the facts, responsible party and applicable requirement before recommending an enforcement response
Assemble the evidence file for an enforcement case, linking each alleged violation to the inspection findings, records and samples that prove it
Review automated anomaly flags in facility monitoring reports, confirming or dismissing each flag against the underlying data before referral
Verify a facility's self-reported emissions or discharge values against independent remote-sensing or ambient data, stating the discrepancy and its uncertainty

competencyTargets.label: Conduct environmental impact review of proposed actions
Select, justify and document the appropriate level of environmental review
Build and maintain a defensible administrative record
Direct and evaluate applicant- or contractor-prepared environmental documents
Coordinate lead, cooperating and participating agencies to a shared schedule
Assess effects on protected species and conduct interagency consultation on proposed actions
Review effects of proposed actions on historic properties and resolve them through consultation
Analyze regulatory, planning and public-comment text at scale with traceable citations
Validate AI-generated work products before professional use
Analyze cumulative burdens and distributional effects of environmental decisions
Design proportionate public engagement when participation is discretionary
Identify and analyze the parties affected by or interested in a decision
Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions
Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty
Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary
Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure
Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work
Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work
Record provenance and AI involvement in work products
Practise cultural humility in community, field and team work
Design accessible, inclusive public engagement and services
Build working partnerships with communities affected by environmental decisions

topTasks.statement: Prepare an environmental assessment of a proposed action, analyzing the reasonably foreseeable effects of the action and its alternatives within the procedure's page and time limits
Scope the review of a proposed action with cooperating agencies and the public, setting the purpose, alternatives and effects boundaries the analysis will cover
Verify AI-drafted sections of an environmental document against the project record, correcting unsupported statements and recording which text was machine-drafted
Determine whether a proposed action requires an environmental assessment or a full impact statement, documenting the significance reasoning in the project record
Screen a proposed action against the agency's exclusion categories and extraordinary-circumstance criteria, recording the screening result and its basis for the official
Review automated exclusion-screening results for a batch of routine actions, confirming or overriding each flagged extraordinary circumstance
Coordinate review steps with other agencies holding authority over the same action, so that duplicated analyses and conflicting requirements are identified early
Update public milestone and dashboard entries for a covered project, reconciling each entry against agency source documents every reporting period
Index documents into the administrative record with dates, authors and provenance labels, marking which content was produced with AI assistance
Confirm that every substantive comment in a docket has a reasoned response, sampling machine-grouped comments for unique points the grouping missed
Code a public comment set into themes with machine assistance, tracing every coded statement to its source passage before summarizing for decision-makers.
Sample machine-grouped public comments to confirm that substantive and unique comments were not merged away before responses are drafted.
